review_comments: Why is the default triggering WAF?

I don't know what August has setup in their rule-set (and I don't expect them to tell us).   We had a similar problem with the original tesla integration a while back and we never were able to figure out exactly which cookie or behavior in the session triggered Telsa's WAF but a separate session solved it.
As discussed on Discord, this is interesting to research at some point. For now, going o merge it in to fix the issue at hand.
